title: Receive the belonging you did not manufacture
summary: The line refuses to let self-importance dress itself as honesty, intelligence, or force. Let this stay near the next choice: hold onto this: belonging is received from the One who holds everyone.
takeaway: Treat ego as illness, not identity.
lifeApplication: When the face heats or the throat tightens, pause and refuse to grant ego the status of truth.

source.shortMeaning: Belonging is received from the One who already holds everyone.
source.lifeApplication: Before defending your place, remember who already holds you there.
